name: EPA Brownfields Assessment, Cleanup and Revolving Loan Fund Grants (FY 2027)
key_terms: Cleanup grants capped at $500,000; 20% cost share for Cleanup and RLF. No Multipurpose grants this round.

name: Elective (direct) pay for clean electricity credits (48E / 45Y)
key_terms: Still available to governments, schools and nonprofits. Wind and solar had to start construction by 2026-07-04 or must be in service by 2027-12-31. Storage has later deadlines. Foreign-entity sourcing rules apply.

name: Elective (direct) pay for clean electricity credits (48E / 45Y): hydropower
key_terms: Still available to governments, schools and nonprofits. Hydropower has later deadlines than wind and solar; the exact dates were not checked. Foreign-entity sourcing rules apply.

name: Energy community bonus
key_terms: A 10-point adder on the clean electricity credits, not a grant. Only applies if the base credit does. A project qualifies by its location: a statistical area or coal-closure census tract on the IRS lists, or a brownfield site. The note says what the Treasury data show for this county; the project's own tract still needs checking.

name: USDA Rural Energy for America Program (REAP)
key_terms: Grant awards were halted in March 2026 and the funding notice rescinded in April. A rewritten rule took effect 2026-10-16. Applicants are farms and rural small businesses, not governments. Check for an open notice.

name: DOE Weatherization Assistance Program
key_terms: Funded at $329M for FY 2026. The FY 2027 budget request proposes $0. Households apply through state and local agencies.

name: FEMA hazard mitigation grants
key_terms: Not checked. Confirm the program, eligibility and deadlines with FEMA before relying on it.
